caption: The drawing is a monochromatic map labeled "California" at the top, depicting a stretch of the California coast with the Pacific Ocean to the left. Several missions are marked along this coastal route, with names such as S. Francisco Solano, S. Clara de Asis, S. Juan Bautista, S. Luis Obispo, La Purisima Concepcion, S. Buenaventura, S. Gabriel Arcangel, and S. Diego de Alcala, among others. The route and mission locations are marked with small black dots and text. In the upper right corner, there is a cluster of six detailed flags, including early American flags and one labeled "CALIFORNIA," all on flagpoles tied together. Below the flags is a ribbon with "1769-1837" written on it. The background includes faint ornamental flourishes and the faint label "Oceano Pacifico" in cursive script across the left side. In the lower left corner, there is a decorative compass rose, and near the bottom edge, an old sailing ship on the water is labeled "CALIFORNIA." The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black with fine, precise linework.
title: Map
